artworks.title: Fauldon, South Greenhoe, Norfolk
artworks.medium: graphite and brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed and textured church with a partially ruined tower on the right side. The structure features gothic architectural elements like arched windows and doorways. Trees extend into the distance towards a low horizon line under an expansive sky filled with light brown and beige. The ground is depicted with earth tones, patches of grass and foliage, using loose brushwork. The color palette consists of muted browns, grays, and beiges, creating a historical atmosphere.

artworks.title: Ruined Church
artworks.medium: graphite with gray and brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed architectural sketch of a large, partially ruined structure with a tall, decaying tower and an adjoining building. The tower is to the right, with an arched entrance and faded, overgrown window arches. The main building extends to the left, ending in a smaller structure with a peaked roof. The horizon is low, marked by the base of the structure, with sparse vegetation and a dirt path. The brushstrokes are delicate, creating texture and depth. The color palette includes soft browns, grays, and beige. In the background, faint trees rise behind the buildings, set against a blank sky.

artworks.title: Boy Milking Cow
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on heavy wove paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of a person and a cow. The image shows a person seated on a small wooden stool beside a large cow with white and brown patches. The cow stands calmly, and the person appears to be engaged in an activity on the cow's side. The background consists of earth-toned colors and is minimally detailed.

artworks.title: Cottage at Diss
artworks.artist: British 19th Century, after John Sell Cotman
artworks.description: The image shows a ground-level perspective of a worn and damaged roofed structure surrounded by vegetation. The style is a pencil sketch with delicate brushstrokes creating shading and texture. The roof is partially collapsed with visible wooden slats. Three pigs are lounging on the ground, with trees and foliage in the background. The color palette is monochromatic with whites and grays.

artworks.title: Gorge with Tree Stumps
artworks.medium: graphite with brown and gray wash and white heightening on gray wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a rocky landscape with a narrow passage between cliffs. The horizon is high, with the sky at the top of the image. Brushstrokes indicate clouds or mist. The colors are mainly earth tones. In the distance, there is light suggesting an open space beyond the rocks.

artworks.title: Landscape Sketch with Bridge and Castle
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a serene landscape. The horizon is depicted higher in the sketch with outlines of structures, potentially a bridge and buildings. The sketch is done in pencil with soft strokes, creating an impressionistic sense. Different shades of grey define the objects, while the paper is left bare for the sky and lighter areas. Close to us, there are indistinct shapes, potentially rocks or foliage. In the distance, there is a suggestion of trees or dense vegetation, framing the buildings in the sketch.

artworks.title: Bridge at Knaresborough
artworks.artist: James Bulwer, after John Sell Cotman
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a gently sloping riverbank leading to a calm river. The horizon is high with rolling hills and a distant structure in view. A bridge with multiple arches spans the river below the horizon. Lush, tree-lined banks are on either side. The painting features fluid and soft brush strokes, creating a serene atmosphere. The color palette includes muted greens, browns, blues, and grays. The river reflects the surrounding scenery.

artworks.title: Ruined Tomb Inscribed "A.M.G."
artworks.description: The image shows a monument-like structure, potentially a tombstone, with the letters "A.M.G." engraved on it. Lush foliage partially blocks the view of the structure, depicted with fine pencil strokes. The drawing has a contrast between detailed and broader shading techniques. The color scheme is monochromatic, with varying shades of gray and the paper color. The artist's signature is visible at the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Sketch of Buildings with Cart and Horses in Foreground
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural landscape in a pencil sketch style. The point of view is at a lower angle looking slightly upwards towards structures on the horizon line. There is a small building with a pointy roof, possibly a silo or water tower, and nearby, a couple of vertical structures resembling chimneys. To the right, there is a roof peak suggesting a house or barn. Closest to us is a wooden cart. The sketch technique involves loose and quick lines without defined shading. The color palette is monochrome, consisting of graphite pencil tones. Beyond the cart, vague outlines of shrubbery or trees are visible, adding depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Sketch of Ruined Church Interior with Chair
artworks.medium: graphite heightened with white on gray paper
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed sketch of two intricately carved architectural elements - arches and pillars - on a beige background. One arch is adorned with decorative motifs, and the other pillar has a textured surface and sculpted capital. The composition is centered, with the arches rising and the pillar extending vertically on the right side.

artworks.title: Waterfall with Rocks
artworks.medium: graphite and black chalk, heightened with white chalk, on gray paper
artworks.description: The image shows a natural setting with a waterfall cascading over rocks. The perspective is straightforward, giving a clear frontal view. The horizon line is high, sketched with mountain outlines blending with trees and rocks. The sketch technique is soft and freehand with fine and heavy pencil strokes depicting rock texture, water flow, and vegetation. The space is dominated by large, roughly sketched rocks forming the waterfall. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of grey and black on light beige paper. The waterfall flows into a stream toward the bottom, enhancing depth. In the distance, faint outlines suggest more trees and hills.

artworks.title: Eye Mill in Suffolk
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil drawing of a hilltop with a windmill. The windmill is dominant in the scene, seen slightly below and to the right, allowing a view upwards and towards its side. The horizon line is low, placing the windmill against a mostly clear sky with birds in flight. The artist used varying pressure of pencil strokes to create texture and depth. The color palette is mainly pale gray tones on cream paper. In the distance, there is a small structure and a grazing animal, adding to the sense of space and scale within the landscape.

artworks.title: Landscape with Hills and Water
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view from a distant perspective with serene surroundings. The horizon is placed at the center, showcasing land forms blending with the sky. Soft pencil strokes indicate depth and dimension, with light lines for distant objects and darker shading for closer ones. The color scheme consists of muted shades of grey, black, and light blue. The landscape features gently rolling hills or mounds created using variations in pencil pressure on the paper.

artworks.title: Landscape with Trees
artworks.artist: British 19th Century, after John Sell Cotman
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with trees drawn in pencil. The drawing shows a cluster of trees with varying strokes to differentiate between the foliage and land contours. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of graphite to highlight depth and texture. A path runs through the trees with two small figures walking along it, providing scale to the scene.

artworks.title: A Dry Dock
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch showing a coastal scene. The horizon line is visible with hills or cliffs meeting the sky. In the distance, there is a ship with outlined sails. The sketch uses light pencil strokes, creating an unfinished look. The color palette is primarily monochrome with gray tones on beige paper. Closest to us on the right side, there are detailed lines indicating another vessel or structure, with smaller shapes suggesting coastal elements like rocks or debris.

artworks.title: Landscape with Church
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of a landscape view. The perspective is from a lower vantage point, leading towards a central structure resembling a castle or large building with a tower. The horizon is above the center, with rolling hills and the structure visible. The pencil work is soft with loosely drawn lines and shading, creating an ethereal quality. The color palette is monochromatic, using pencil tones against cream-colored paper for contrast. Vegetation or bushes are suggested closer to the viewer, with the structure and terrain in the middle ground fading into the distance.

artworks.title: Mountain Scene with Rocks
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash and white heightening on paper washed blue
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with mountains and rocky formations. The view is slightly elevated, showing the scene from a nearby vantage point. The horizon is hidden by the mountains. Loose brushstrokes in blue and gray tones create depth and mist. Close-up rocks have darker strokes, leading to distant peaks blending into the sky. The color palette is muted with blues and grays. The overall mood is somber and tranquil. The technique gives a dreamlike quality to the landscape.

artworks.title: View of Church Lane, Bristol
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 25.5 x 21.2 cm (10 1/16 x 8 3/8 in.)
support: 43.4 x 34.2 cm (17 1/16 x 13 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a street view with old houses featuring steep, reddish-brown tiled roofs. The horizon shows distant buildings partially obscured by mist, blending into a pale sky with subtle cloud patterns. The painting's brushstrokes are delicate and precise in capturing architectural details. The color palette includes earthy tones for the buildings and a light blue-gray sky, creating a calm ambiance. In the distance, other faded structures enhance the artwork's depth and perspective.

artworks.title: Bridge Near Waters-Meet, Lynton, North Devon
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a river or stream. The scene is framed by dense trees, with a wooden bridge crossing the middle. The painting shows trees, rocks, water, and the bridge with delicate brushstrokes. The color palette consists of sepia and earth tones, creating a calming atmosphere. The foreground has rocks and water, while the background shows misty trees for depth.

artworks.title: Castle on a Hill
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on gray-green wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays a green and brown rolling hill landscape with a castle on top. The horizon is high in the composition, showing the castle in the distance. The castle is small and white and grey in color, contrasting with the earthy surroundings. The painting is in a landscape orientation with fluid brushstrokes typical of watercolor. The color palette includes earthy greens, browns, reddish-brown, off-white, blues, and greys, creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch landscape drawn from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is visible across the upper third of the composition. The landscape features outlines of trees and structures in the distance. The sketch uses light pencil strokes, creating a minimalistic and ethereal quality. Near the viewer are loosely drawn bushes and vegetation. The color palette is monochromatic with soft grey tones on off-white paper.

artworks.title: Ragland
artworks.description: This pencil drawing depicts an old stone building partially covered by vines and surrounded by trees. The perspective is from a slightly elevated angle, with a pathway leading into the space. An arched doorway is visible in the center. The structure shows intricate brickwork, arched windows, and a cylindrical tower on the left side. Trees and foliage are rendered with light pencil strokes. The graphite color palette provides a detailed representation with shading to create depth. The drawing includes a note saying "England June 25, 1829."

artworks.title: Shore Scene with Boats in Choppy Water
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a coastal scene from an elevated viewpoint, showing the sea meeting the sky on the high horizon. Several boats with brown sails float across the water. The brushwork is fluid, capturing the waves with soft strokes. The color palette is muted with browns and grays. In the foreground, there are tracks on the sandy shore and weathered wooden beams. In the distance, small figures are visible.

artworks.title: Tower Overlooking Water
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of a waterfront scene with a body of water in the foreground. There are various architectural elements, including a prominent tower, distant structures, and boats. The sketch features light and suggestive brushstrokes and pencil work, emphasizing the essence over details. The color palette is subtle, with muted tans and greys creating a delicate atmosphere. Small boats with figures are near the observer, while the background includes additional structures and vessels.
